significance: A Paadal Petra Sthalam glorified in the Tevaram, begun under the Pallavas, enlarged by the Cholas and rebuilt in the 16th century under the Nayaks. Its 10th- and 11th-century inscriptions and its link to the Battle of Takkolam give it particular historical weight.
story: The region is said to have been swamped by floodwaters that rose to Shiva's waist, and Parvati embraced him in fear as the waters came.
